actual: Research Assistant chat fails on broad natural-language data-sync questions with Unknown MCP profile 'qlib_data'. The assistant should resolve a user intent to a valid MCP profile or safe fallback through unified processing logic, not emit a profile-specific error for one question. This appears to be a generic assistant routing/profile-resolution bug affecting multiple natural-language queries and MCP domains.
